name: Brunello
summary: Brunello exudes a refined sculptural presence, beginning with a top in silvery grey travertine marble that radiates quiet opulence in a soft matte finish. Its body is enveloped in elegantly textured faux leather, while the inner panels are finished in warm melamine tones for added depth. Accentuated by black matte-painted metal piping and decorative details, this piece brings together material richness and architectural harmony with unmistakable sophistication. 240x45x80
